description: Compute the correlation for the whole and each stratum
content: Splits into strata by the param stratify (species / sex / island) and tables Pearson's r, its 95% confidence interval and the regression slope for the whole and each stratum. Marks strata whose r has the opposite sign to the whole.

outputs.name: points
outputs.description: CSV of the points with a stratum column

outputs.name: correlations
outputs.description: CSV of r for the whole and each stratum
